notes.title: Tower Princess Update 1.04 - New Feature!!!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Community Feature[/h1]
Greetings fellow knights!

Our community has asked to keep the princess you've chosen to rescue once you defeat together the Evil Dragon, so...

We've heard you! Before, once you've beaten the game with a princess, you could only find her crown at her regular spot at the Entry Hall, as she has already been rescued. Now she's back with the crown over her head, so you can storm the dungeon together, AGAIN!

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Once you've beaten the game with a princess or prince they no longer disappear
[*] Fixed small issue with Sunder special ability
[*] Fixed Kobold bards endlessly buffing themselves
[*] Minor lighting and collision fixes

[/list]
+ Some bug fixes
+ Minor improvements


If you like it, you can consider leaving a positive review on Steam, adding your suggestions or feedback for next updates, thanks a lot!

notes.title: Tower Princess Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi Knights, we continue working with your feedback and here is the list of this update:

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Disable gamepad vibration setting added
[*] Added Splash screen when you receive damage
[*] Now the castle room with the levers doesn't restart each time you enter
[*] Elemental spirit animations management improved
[*] Rattrap damage increased now kills kobolds in hard diff
[*] Damage numbers on enemies displayed
[*] Amour enemy now can receive the minimun damage if It still has plates
[*] Chakrams damage fixed
[*] Fixed Bureaucrat text progress
[/list]

+Some minor bug fixes
+Some minor changes

If you like it, you can consider leaving a positive review on Steam, adding your suggestions or feedback for next updates, thanks a lot!

notes.title: Tower Princess Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hi Knights, we heard your feedback and we made some requested changes + improvements, here are some of their :

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Balanced Difficulties
[*] Fixed Cartograph Achievement
[*] Improved Gamepad support
[*] Fixed Menu navigation
[*] Now the Crystals Puzzle room now is optional and grants you a chest
[*] Some platform jumps  are now easier
[*] The bard can not heal himself now
[*] Increased gift drop
[*] Increased bard drop
[*] Increased kobold drop
[*] Increased 2nd basic attack combo speed
[*] Increased 3nd basic attack combo speed and area
[*] Decreased cooldown for sword special abilities
[*] Decreased cooldown for princesses abilities
[*] Decreased cooldown for Zombie Princess power, but now only heals the half
[/list]
+Some bug fixes
+Minor changes

notes.title: Meet Human Princess! Release in ONE week!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello friendly folks![/h3]

[h3]We want to remind you that Tower Princess is coming out just in one week! On September 8 for PC, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch!

Please, check out our awesome release trailer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=7GlCrRdRH-g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]XBOX One ver. will come out just in a few weeks, we'll announce it later.[/h3]

[h3]We also want to introduce to you [b]Human Princess[/b] and tell you about her backstory, character and quirks![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/b24d635132438d67e3fedf2c188a206a1e714640.png[/img]

[h3]Bio: [/h3]

The Human Princess has all the things you may expect from a perfect princess, as such fine beauty, refined manners, an evil stepmother, or a dark omen upon birth. 

The tale tells that the court wizard (because everyone knows there’s a wizard in any respected court) foresaw that once the Human Princess reached adulthood a relentless Evil Dragon would appear, burning down the royal castle. Only to lock her in the highest among the highest towers. And of course, only True Love could save her from that fate.

Everyone also knows that a wizard can’t be wrong. So the King and Queen only found a possible way to prevent such an omen... Helping her to find a charming prince before it’s too late Building themselves the highest tower, and locking there the princess. You can’t imprison someone who is already imprisoned. Logical, isn’t it?

In that way, the Human Princess grew up with all the comfort and luxury anyone would have ever dreamt of, but was forever locked on a tower. All she had to do was to find her true love, but as her lifestyle didn’t make her too sociable, it was such a hard task.

In the end, and to everyone’s surprise, the Evil Dragon ended up appearing and burning down the castle as expected. Though the Dragon has taken her to his own castle, the Human Princess's life hasn’t changed so much.

And there she is, still waiting to be rescued. If it was hard to rescue her due to her bad temper, now there’s also a big red dragon in the way. Now any proper suitor must be ready for both challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/c2758b856075a90513f3f694cab8fae30ccfc3c2.gif[/img]

[h3]Favorite food:[/h3]

Which kind of princess wouldn’t like sweets? 

Imagine the most refined chefs of the land, cooking the finest meals you can conceive just for you. Even more, imagine the most exquisite tea accompanied by the sweetest sweets and cookies. It’s good, and even better if you can have as much as you want, right?

Now imagine how may a bunch of kobolds cook. Aside from that food isn’t enough for princess standards, those pants-less lizards don’t know how to make candies or have tea. And that seems a reason more than enough to want to be rescued as soon as possible.


[h3]Date of Birth:[/h3]

October 16th, just 19 years before the Dragon showed up!

Being born under a cursed moon that only exists every few years doesn’t seem a good idea, but one doesn’t decide its own birthday. 

That defined her life of confinement. But no one imagined that the Dragon came looking for lots of princesses, and the Human Princess was only one of them. So maybe, and only maybe, it was impossible to prevent the dragon's arrival. We’ll never know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/cc29d60846a042f7d9117990de2e27e522c567a4.png[/img]

[h3]Likes:[/h3]

- To sing, and even dance, when she’s doing her tasks. But only when no one is near. The only ones that have heard her are the little birdies that were in the tower, so she isn’t sure if she actually sings well. 
- Have we already mentioned sweets? 
- Being a princess, of course. Yes, the life of confinement can be quite boring, but despite that, she loved the attention she received there and all the beautiful and shining things she had in her tower.
- And of course, she loves the idea of being rescued by a knight in shining armour. But not any knight, only the one that proves to be worthy of rescuing her, and of treating her as she really deserves. After all, she’s still a wealthy and highly refined princess.

[h3]Dislikes:[/h3]

- Dragons, or anything similar, for obvious reasons.
- Humdrum, vulgar, and poorly mannered suitors. Or what are the same, suitors who do not live up to her expectations.
- Poisoned fruit, sewing with fluorescent spinning wheels, or crystal shoes. Why should a princess like those things? The crystal shoes still have a pass (they are like walking barefoot, but without soiling your feet!), but they rub her feet, and that’s not nice!
- But above all, what she hates the most is waiting for that knight in shining armour. It’s taking a lifetime of boredom.
